name: 34731 · Fruitland Pk, FL
findings: ZIP 34731 (Fruitland Pk) has 30 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (55% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 34731 (Fruitland Pk) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 34731 (Fruitland Pk) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 51% of the typical level).
